summary: iteration_9 backend + frontend full regression PASS. 90/90 pytest (74 previous + 16 new for streak / login rate-limit / async scan) all green. Frontend UI verified: streak chip renders with flame + number '3' on a streak>=2 project and is absent on streak<2. Scan-confirm-dialog opens on click and calling /scan without a github connection shows the expected 'GitHub is not connected' error toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1900 lines — still growing without modularization; consider splitting into auth/, projects/, billing/, digest/ routers.

Login rate limit keys on email only (documented in-code) — an attacker probing many emails from many IPs is unaffected; that's a per-account brute-force gate, not a global bot gate. Acceptable per handoff note but worth surfacing.

_run_scan schedules via asyncio.create_task on the request loop — if the worker process restarts mid-scan, the scans row stays in 'running' forever with no reaper. Consider a periodic sweeper that marks stale running scans as 'error' (e.g. started_at > 5min ago and still running).
GET /api/scans/{id} filters by user_id (good, ownership tested).
